# Daily Briefing – Friday 11 September

Yesterday was a solid low-key day. No structured session, 8,518 steps keeping you nicely active, and you actually burned 2,401 kcal — just above your 2,300 target, which is a good place to be for steady weight progress toward that 80-85kg goal.

Recovery is looking mixed. HRV at 98ms sits just below your 99-118ms baseline, and only 5.3 hours sleep is the real concern here — that's not enough to rebuild properly. Your resting HR of 50bpm and stress score of 31 are genuinely encouraging though, so you're not in the red.

Prioritise sleep tonight above everything else — that's your biggest lever right now. Aim for 7-8 hours and protect it. On nutrition, hit your 175g protein today to support recovery; spread it across meals rather than cramming it late. You're doing well — keep building.
